name: options_chain_real
description: The strike pills must be showing REAL upstream option quotes, not the locally synthesized Black-Scholes fallback. strikes_overlay_active only counts rows and passes on a fabricated chain, so this asserts strikes_are_real instead. Guards the whole options path end to end: ApexData reachable (LAN candidate failover working), chain fetch returning rows, and the overlay populated from upstream rather than from send_placeholder_chain.

steps.message: And the rows came from upstream -- NOT the synthesized Black-Scholes fallback. A failure here means ApexData was unreachable and the axis pills are showing fabricated bids/asks.
